1135. Java Stream API Word Filter

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
Develop a Java program that reads a list of words from the user, uses the Stream API to filter out words with more than 5 characters, converts the filtered words to uppercase, and then prints the resulting list. Use var to declare all local variables.
input_spec: An integer n denoting the number of words in the list. n space-separated words representing the list elements.
output_spec: The resulting list of uppercase words, each word on a new line.
